about.title: About Me
about.bio1: I'm a Python developer passionate about building intelligent solutions with artificial intelligence and machine learning. I enjoy turning complex problems into practical, scalable applications that deliver real-world value.
about.bio2: My experience spans the entire machine learning lifecycle, from data analysis and model development to deployment and maintenance. I focus on creating clean, efficient, and maintainable systems, with particular interest in AI-powered applications, automation, and data-driven solutions.
about.bio3: Outside of development, I enjoy exploring emerging technologies, reading about advancements in AI, contributing to open-source projects, and experimenting with new tools and frameworks.
about.exp1_desc: Designing and developing AI-powered applications,intelligent chatbots, n8n and LLM-driven automation workflows. Building scalable solutions that leverage modern AI technologies to solve real-world business challenges.
about.exp2_desc: Developed RAG systems, machine learning models and data-driven solutions for predictive analytics, and pattern recognition. Worked accross the ML lifecycle, including data preparation, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
about.exp3_desc: Built and maintained responsive web application, and collaborated on feature implementation. Gained hands-on experience with modern web development practices, database integration, and version control workflows.

rag.title: RAG System
rag.overview: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that combines semantic search with large language models. Documents are embedded using sentence-transformers, stored in ChromaDB for vector search, and relevant context is retrieved to ground LLM responses.
rag.step3_desc: Top-k similar documents extracted from vector DB
rag.step4_desc: LLM generates answer grounded in retrieved context
rag.feature1: Semantic document search with configurable k-value
rag.feature2: LLM-agnostic: works with Ollama (local) or OpenAI API
rag.feature3: Recommendation API returns ranked document suggestions
rag.feature4: Fallback response mode when LLM is unavailable
rag.chat_greeting: Hello! I'm the RAG chatbot. Ask me anything about Python, machine learning, or AI topics. I'll retrieve relevant context from my knowledge base to answer.
rag.chat_error: Error connecting to server. Make sure the server is running.
anomaly.title: Anomaly Detection in Bank Transactions
anomaly.overview: ML-powered anomaly detection system that identifies fraudulent bank transactions in real-time. Uses Isolation Forest (with Autoencoder option) trained on transaction features like amount, time, location, and merchant category.
anomaly.test_error: Error: Could not connect to server.
n8n.title: n8n WhatsApp Conversation Automation
n8n.overview: An automated workflow built with n8n that handles WhatsApp conversations end-to-end. Incoming messages are classified by intent, matched against a knowledge base using RAG, and answered with personalized AI-generated responses — all without human intervention.
n8n.step1_desc: Receive incoming WhatsApp message via Twilio/WABA webhook
n8n.step2_desc: Extract sender, content, timestamp. Validate and sanitize input.
n8n.step3_desc: LLM classifies intent: support, sales, or general inquiry
n8n.step4_desc: RAG retrieval from vector DB for context-aware answers
n8n.step5_desc: LLM crafts personalized response using intent + context
n8n.step6_desc: Send response back via WhatsApp Business API
n8n.feature4: Fallback to human agent when needed
n8n.config_step1: Import the workflow JSON into n8n
